title: Investigative talking points
rankingMethod: Editorial triage by evidence strength, allocation scale and verifiable next question; not corruption likelihood or a statistical risk score. Amounts overlap; do not add them.

findings.title: RCS: identical budget packages across unequal rainfall proxies
findings.basis: Direct allocation observation; rainfall need remains a proxy
findings.question: What policy or engineering design justifies one identical budget unit per office?
findings.evidence: All district-office RCS lines have the same amount. Province/regional rainfall proxies differ by 2.59×. Alternative formulas move different numbers of budget units. All 199 DEO lines are retained unchanged in HGAB; no differentiated needs weighting is visible in the amounts.
findings.alternative: Standard package costs or a minimum coverage policy may justify equal allocations. Rainfall alone does not measure demand.
findings.next: Obtain siting, design capacity, water demand, catchment area and existing RCS inventory.
findings.caution: DEO is not LEG; province rainfall is not a district observation. Returning FY2026 program.

findings.title: HGAB-only domestic candidates: verify the counterpart before calling an insertion
findings.question: Which candidates are genuinely absent from NEP after wording, scope and occurrence review?
findings.evidence: Native schedule totals reconcile; unmatched domestic records remain distinct from unpaired FAP review lines.
findings.alternative: Wrapped titles, OCR, changes in office or PAP, renaming and aggregated occurrences can hide counterparts.
findings.next: Stratified original-page adjudication; estimate false positives before extrapolating counts.
findings.caution: Do not adopt another analyst’s additions count as ground truth. FAPs take a separate review path.

findings.title: Recurring project titles: inspect overlapping work before alleging duplication
findings.lead: 634 of 737 NEP comparison pairs clearly retained in HGAB
findings.question: Are new appropriations paying for already-funded components or legitimate continuation?
findings.evidence: 591 of 686 distinct NEP repeat-screen proposals have clear HGAB links. 21 proposals have explicit overlapping historical chainage. ₱27.260B is the unique NEP proposal allocation, not alleged loss.
findings.alternative: Multi-year implementation, rehabilitation and distinct components can share names and segments.
findings.next: Prioritize explicitly overlapping retained proposals and high amounts; compare contracts, quantities, tranche scopes and completion.
findings.caution: The 737 headline counts NEP–old GAA comparison pairs. Potential retention and missing counterparts remain separate.

findings.title: Exact ₱5M road and flood allocations cluster in the same offices
findings.lead: 35 overlapping offices vs 21.7 expected under independence
findings.question: Does standard design, office workload or coordinated allocation explain the co-occurrence?
findings.evidence: Office odds ratio 5.34; unadjusted exact p=5.07e-06. Region-controlled result is also unusual under its stated null.
findings.alternative: Common specifications, office workload and project mix can create clustering.
findings.next: Pre-specify work-type and workload controls; inspect quantities and comparable prior-year prices.
findings.caution: Threshold/category selection was post hoc. Association does not establish procurement splitting or intent.

findings.title: INSPIRE: a large returning named appropriation needs a whole-project ledger
findings.question: What is the total approved cost and which unfinished components explain the new appropriation?
findings.evidence: Named GAA lines exist in FY2023 and FY2025; FY2027 is not a first appearance.
findings.alternative: A legitimate phased project can require multiple appropriations.
findings.next: Obtain total project cost, phases, progress, obligations, disbursements and procurement records.
findings.caution: Appropriations are not actual spending; stage/year sums do not prove duplication.

rcs.correlation: Undefined: allocation variance is zero; no correlation p-value reported.

scope: FY2027 NEP/HGAB 3rd reading; historical GAA comparisons where locally available. No GAB/GAA 2027 outcome inferred.
